content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Research Associate II Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: This position follows Funding Agency norms, not Institute norms. Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree, or 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech, with at least one research paper in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. From graduation onwards: minimum 60% or equivalent grade. Class 10th and 12th: 55% or equivalent grade. Research experience in Pharmacy, Pharmacology, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computational Chemistry, Biophysics, or allied disciplines. Demonstrated expertise in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, molecular docking, cheminformatics, virtual screening, molecular modelling, and computational analysis of protein-ligand interactions. Proficiency in relevant computational tools and platforms (for example GROMACS, AMBER, AutoDock, Schrödinger, RDKit) and programming languages such as Python. Familiarity with AI/ML approaches for drug discovery or molecular property prediction, which will be an added advantage. Evidence of relevant research expertise through peer-reviewed publications or demonstrated research outcomes. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The Research Associate will contribute to computational research activities under the project. The key responsibilities are: Perform MD simulations, molecular docking, and computational studies of protein-ligand interactions. Undertake cheminformatics analysis, virtual screening, and structure-based identification and optimization of potential therapeutic molecules. Develop and implement computational workflows for molecular modelling, simulation, and analysis of biological systems. Integrate computational predictions with experimental findings to support hypothesis generation, compound prioritization, and validation. Collaborate with experimental and AI/ML research teams to support interdisciplinary research objectives. Analyze and interpret computational results, prepare scientific reports and manuscripts, and contribute to project deliverables.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting or appointment, and a higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test, and not to fill the position through this round of selection, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is a temporary position, and the appointment is for one year.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Research Associate II Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the IIT Gandhinagar project staff application portal . Submit your application there before the last date closes.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply without a Ph.D.?
faq.answer: Yes, if you have 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech and at least one research paper in an SCI journal. An MD, MS, MDS or equivalent degree also meets the requirement.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply if my thesis is submitted but not yet defended?
faq.answer: Yes. Research scholars who have submitted their theses and are likely to defend soon may also submit the application.

faq.question: Q3. What marks do I need?
faq.answer: You need a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.

faq.question: Q4. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 60,000 - 90,000/- remuneration?
faq.answer: No. The consolidated monthly remuneration already includes HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Which software skills will help my application?
faq.answer: The desirable tools are GROMACS, AMBER, AutoDock, Schrödinger and RDKit, along with programming languages such as Python.

faq.question: Q6. Is the post an experimental or a computational role?
faq.answer: It is computational, but the Research Associate will also work with experimental and AI/ML research teams and integrate predictions with experimental findings.

faq.question: Q7. Whom can I contact about this position?
faq.answer: The contact is the Principal Investigator, Sharad Gupta, at [email protected].
